title: Roll definitions
confidence: confirmed names and ladder / melee and ranged inputs confirmed, evasion and endure inferred
notes: The sheet's four rolls as records, which is the whole point of Concept 08: the sheet hardwires them into two layouts as duplicated formula blocks, so 'add initiative' means editing both. Here it is one row each.
**Melee and ranged inputs are confirmed** — the raw stat, proven twice over: input 10 at Str 10 and input 11 at Dex 11, each producing the decomposition Calculator!G17:N20 shows.

**Evasion and endure are NOT.** The sheet's inputs are 18 and 16 for a character with Dex 11 and Con 12, so each carries an extra term (+7 and +4) that the export does not explain — Concept 08's open question. The fragment ships the raw stat, so those two rolls are honestly *short* rather than fitted with a constant nobody can source. Correcting them is a formula edit once the live Calculator rows are read.
Every roll points at the one ladder in dice-ladders.json, matching the sheet: there is a single `20 | 12 | 6` row and all four rolls run down it.

**This fragment coexists with combat-skills.json on purpose**, mirroring the code: TICKET-ROLL-05 adds `RollDefinition` alongside `CombatSkill`, and TICKET-ROLL-06 is what removes the older one. Ids are prefixed `rolldef-` so the two sets do not collide in the merge. Expect combat-skills.json to be deleted, not merged, when ROLL-06 lands.

`applies_to` and `visibility` are Concept 08 fields the shape does not model yet (deferred until there is a creature and a second view). The sheet's creature call sheet uses the same four names, which is what `applies_to: both` would say.
